cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dad, come to my sculpture opening. I need someone I trust beside the big piece; I'll show you where to stand.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't need to explain it. Help me unpack it: support the base, never the thin arm. I'd like you there for that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother will be there. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come at five, before Mum arrives. We'll unpack it together, then I'll take you round. Let me show you what I've made before the room fills up.
